name: 01_primary_spectra
title: MC-truth primary spectra
scope: Full certified primary files, not processed spans or observed clusters
uncertainty: SD of 400 whole-file resamples; densities divide by exact bin width

name: 02_common_cluster_spectra
title: Common-positive cluster energy spectra
scope: Same MC-positive candidates; common denominator; three models averaged descriptively
uncertainty: File SD of the mean fixed-model histogram; histogram ratio is not detector efficiency

name: 03_selected_A1
title: Selected spectra A1
scope: C2/C3 identical positive IDs; C4 adds native-label negatives; no B selection
uncertainty: 400 shared file draws; common denominator; full-range C2/C3 integrals checked

name: 04_selected_B1
title: Selected spectra B1
scope: C2/C3 identical positive IDs; C4 adds native-label negatives; no B selection
uncertainty: 400 shared file draws; common denominator; full-range C2/C3 integrals checked

name: 05_roc_pr
title: Test ROC and precision-recall
scope: Each fold/seed separately; no pooled AUC or test retuning
uncertainty: 400 potential-by-fold file draws; displayed interpolation of fixed 401-grid; accepted AUC/AP remain exact

name: 06_score_distributions
title: Score distributions
scope: Fold-separated MC classes; background target zero is not a physical energy
uncertainty: 400 file draws; equal three-model average

name: 07_energy_mc_positive
title: Test energy response mc_positive
scope: Target is maximum initial MCTrack energy; selected populations differ by arm
uncertainty: Mean ± SD of 3 seed metrics; median/width sampling error not estimated; MIN_BIN=25

name: 08_energy_selected_positive
title: Test energy response selected_positive
scope: Target is maximum initial MCTrack energy; selected populations differ by arm
uncertainty: Mean ± SD of 3 seed metrics; median/width sampling error not estimated; MIN_BIN=25

name: 09_energy_selection
title: Energy-dependent efficiency and purity
scope: Mean of fixed-model ratios; actual MC-positive candidate denominator
uncertainty: 400 shared whole-file draws

name: 10_cluster_size
title: Quality versus cluster size
scope: All accepted test folds; candidate-level metrics
uncertainty: Mean ± SD over three seed-labelled fold averages

name: 11_migration
title: Cluster energy migration
scope: All MC-positive candidates, every seed; row sum can be <1 because reco tails are tabulated
uncertainty: Finite-sample conditional frequencies; no per-cell CI, not an unfolded response

name: 17_all_potential_pairs
title: Every potential pair
scope: Accepted processed-span truth and reconstructed C4; same saved paired replicas
uncertainty: 400 shared saved whole-file draws

name: 18_label_floor_scan
title: S286 label-floor scan
scope: Accepted S286 observations, no score/model calls
uncertainty: 400 potential-by-part shared group draws

name: 19_soft_origins
title: S286 soft targets and origins
scope: Qualifying-hit category, not full-cluster purity or primary efficiency
uncertainty: 400 shared group draws

name: 12_head_histories
title: Validation head histories
scope: Native MC labels/targets; independent per-head first argmin
uncertainty: Three fixed seed trajectories, no CI

name: 13_threshold_scans
title: Validation threshold scans
scope: 401 fixed score cuts; first count purity >=0.70; potentials pooled
uncertainty: Three fixed seed curves, no CI

name: 14_calibration_validation
title: Validation calibration response
scope: Accepted maps reapplied, no fit; all positive validation candidates
uncertainty: Three fixed-model curves; sampling error not estimated

name: 15_delta_bias
title: Potential-dependent test bias
scope: All MC-positive test clusters, each seed and both potential differences
uncertainty: 400 whole-file bootstrap SD

name: 16_heldout_ladder
title: Truth-to-reconstruction ladder
scope: Retrospective cross-fit; processed-span primary truth and cluster stages
uncertainty: 400 shared whole-file draws; paired B1-A1

name: 20_crossfit
title: Cross-fit roles
scope: split scheme, no measurement
uncertainty: exact role diagram

name: 21_bias_folds
title: Energy bias by fold
scope: test MC-positive [1.75,3) window
uncertainty: file SD and seed spread separated

name: 22_census
title: Input-group census
scope: Content/event grouping
uncertainty: exact finite inventory counts

name: 23_split_precision
title: Split design precision projection
scope: design diagnostic before training
uncertainty: projected counting precision; not measured model uncertainty
